c.garden_h2: Every word you learn grows into a real plant
c.garden_p: Your garden isn't a scoreboard — it's alive. Each word becomes its own plant, one of 28 real species from oak and lotus to lavender and edelweiss, always the same plant for the same word. Tap a plant and it tells you its name and the word it grew from.

c.f_friends_p: Visit a friend's garden and water it — a gentle nudge to keep their streak. No feeds, no leaderboards.
c.f_account_p: Optional. Sign in on a new phone and everything is there; backups are encrypted on your device first.
c.f_anki_p: Import an .apkg deck as your own word list — even keep the progress you made in Anki.
c.f_ui_p: The app speaks English, French, Spanish and Japanese — menus, meanings and memory hooks.
c.friends_p: Share your friend code and visit each other's gardens. Watering a friend's plants once a day is a small “I'm with you” — they see it the next time they open Bloomko, right when they need a reason to practise.

e.title: Bloomko — learn Chinese & Japanese with handwriting, an offline AI tutor and a garden that grows
e.description: Bloomko is a free, calm app for Chinese and Japanese: write characters by hand with stroke-by-stroke checking, chat with an AI tutor that runs offline on your phone, read graded stories, and watch every word you learn grow into a real plant. Try writing a character right on this page.
e.og_description: Write, read and speak Chinese or Japanese — with handwriting that checks every stroke, an AI tutor that lives on your phone and a garden where every word is a plant. Coming soon.
e.badge: Every word you learn is now a real plant 🌷
e.lead: Learn Chinese or Japanese the way it sticks: write every character by hand, talk with an AI tutor that lives on your phone, read little stories made of the words you know — and watch a garden grow, one plant for every word.
e.tags: ✍️ Stroke-by-stroke writing💬 Chat with Gemma🌷 A plant for every word📝 HSK & JLPT mock exams
e.note_hero: Join the waiting list: be among the first testers when Bloomko opens on Android. No spam, ever.
e.try_p1: This is how Bloomko teaches: watch the stroke order, then draw it yourself with your finger or mouse. Every stroke is checked — a little off the line is fine, the order and direction count.
e.try_p2: Write all four and see how it feels. In the app there are thousands more, with memory tricks, sound and reviews at just the right time.
e.steps_h2: How Bloomko works, in five steps
e.steps_p: Ten or fifteen minutes a day. Bloomko tells you exactly what's next — you just show up.
e.s1p: See it, hear it, trace it, then write it from memory. A memory hook helps every word stick.
e.s2p: A modern memory model brings each word back just before you'd forget it.
e.s3p: Practise every day and your streak plant grows. Every learned word blooms in your garden.
e.s4p: Role-play a café or a train station with Gemma, using only words you know.
e.s5p: Graded stories, dictation and timed HSK or JLPT mock exams show how far you've come.
e.ai_h2: Talk, ask, practise — with a tutor in your pocket
e.ai_p: Bloomko's tutor is built on Gemma, Google's open AI model, and runs entirely on your phone — even in airplane mode. It only uses the words you've already learned, so every conversation is just the right level.
e.ai_list:
• Role-play chats — order at a café, ask the way, meet someone new. Answer by voice or typing; gentle corrections when something's off
  • It listens to you — pronunciation and tone feedback, with your voice's pitch drawn next to the real tone
  • Fresh sentences and stories — made only from words you know, focusing on the ones you get wrong
  • Private — your conversations never leave your phone

e.feat_h2: Everything you need, in one calm app
e.feat_p: Most apps let you tap your way through a language. Bloomko makes you use it — with your hand, your voice, your ears and your memory.
e.f_write_p: Stroke order, tracing, then writing it all by yourself. Every stroke checked — forgiving when you're a little off the line.
e.f_talk_p: Short role-play chats with your AI tutor in everyday scenes, using only the words you know.
e.f_listen_p: Dictation, 48 graded stories where you can tap any word, and comprehension questions.
e.f_tones_p: Hear the four Mandarin tones and see the pitch of your own voice drawn over the real one.
e.f_grammar_p: 500+ grammar points, unlocked as you learn words — examples built from words you already know.
e.f_exam_p: Timed HSK and JLPT practice tests in the real format, with listening and reading parts.
e.f_photo_p: Snap a menu, a sign or a book page. Bloomko reads it, shows what you know and adds the new words.
e.f_look_p: 未 or 末? 己 or 已? Side-by-side practice until you can tell them apart at a glance.
e.hand_h2: Your hand remembers what your eyes forget
e.hand_p: Recognising a character is easy. Writing it from nothing is what makes it yours. Bloomko shows you the stroke order, lets you trace, and then asks you to write it from memory — and every mistake comes back until you get it right.
e.hand_list:
• Animated stroke order for thousands of characters
  • Trace first, then write it all by yourself
  • Wrong answers repeat until they're right
e.hand_alt: Learning a new word in Bloomko with stroke order
e.langs_p: Each course follows the official levels, with words grouped into themed units. Browse every Chinese word or every Japanese word — with stroke order, memory tricks and examples, free.

e.faq:
When can I get Bloomko?

Bloomko is in its last stretch of testing. Android comes first, iPhone follows. Leave your email and you'll be among the first to try it.

Is it free?

Yes — Bloomko is free to download, with no ads.

Do I need an account?

No. Everything works without one and your progress stays on your phone. An account is optional: it keeps your progress safe and the same on all your devices, encrypted before it leaves your phone.

Does it work offline?

Yes. Lessons, reviews, stories and even the AI tutor (Gemma) run on your phone, on a plane or a mountain. You only need the internet for the one-time AI download and, if you want them, sync and backups.

Which levels does it cover?

Chinese: the official HSK 3.0 levels 1–3 (2,270 words). Japanese: kana and JLPT N5–N3 (3,500 words). Plus 500+ grammar points, 48 graded stories and mock exams in the real format.

Can I use my own word lists?

Yes — add words yourself, paste a list, or import an Anki deck (.apkg) and keep the progress you made in Anki.

How does the garden work?

Every word you learn becomes a plant — one of 28 real species, always the same plant for the same word. Review it on time and it grows; skip its reviews and it wilts; forget it for long and it disappears until you practise it again. Friends can visit and water your garden.
e.final_p: Bloomko is almost ready. Leave your email and you'll be among the first to try it on Android — iPhone follows. Every word starts as a seed; yours will bloom soon.

h.title: Bloomko Heritage — learn lesser-known languages: Slovenian now, Icelandic soon
